title: Align the order projection with sealed goal annotations
objective: Eliminate the deterministic goal:orders check failures by projecting each order to {status} (dropping the total field the sealed goal annotations never assert), mirroring the existing bookings projection of {route, changes}.
statement: Applying this change to projectServiceState raises task_success_rate by at least 0.6 on the tau-style e2e baseline task set (task-001/003/004 flip from failed to passed; task-002/005 stay passed, so 2/5 -> 5/5) without regressing any golden case, because every recorded goal:orders failure is agent-independent: the stored actual_sha256 of each failing run equals the digest of a perfect execution under the current projection, and the only mismatch is the extra total key that every sealed orders goal omits.

regressions.summary: tests/workflow-tools.test.ts:110 asserts the current order projection shape {status, total} and must be updated to {status} within the same change, or the unit suite fails (test_pass_rate dips).

Projected order states no longer carry total, so any future goal or policy check that asserts order totals would need the projection re-extended; no current goal_state or policy check reads order.total.
